admissionChecklist.requirement: Parent supplies access, funded balance, spend ceiling and a new study directory; worker has no live-call authorization. Missing inputs remain blocked.
Recheck exact provider model ID and lifecycle, endpoint, region, price mode and account RPM/TPM. Store credential-free admission evidence privately.

Freeze source SHA, patterns/config/prompt hashes, fixture identities, candidate set, settings and judge seats; copy selected documentedCandidates into a separate admitted manifest and rename proposedExtraBody to extraBody. This artifact keeps candidates empty.

Record host separately from upstream family. Current judgeCandidates compares provider only; hold hosted OpenAI rewrite judging until parent reviews a family-aware solution. Never substitute provider names merely to trick filtering.
Use HTTPS HTTP candidates for these hosts; Gemini judges only via existing loopback OpenCodex admission. No Gemini key, direct API or direct CLI fallback.

Parent canary must cover nonempty final content, exact response-model identity, usage, no tools, KO/EN/ZH/JA, bounded output, and production score-schema validity. Check reasoning control and temperature-zero schema retry.

Use sequential requests and private terminal-attempt journals. Allow budget for transport retries, scorer schema retries and both judges. Existing harness has no total-dollar limiter; parent supervises with account spend controls.

Baseline mirrors prompt-only structured output; no response_format on rewrite. A JSON-schema scorer variant requires a separate protocol and correct per-stage schema. Verify truncation/finish reasons and streamed usage privately because current study rows omit finish_reason.

Run 49 scorer fixtures and 12 rewrite screening fixtures once per admitted candidate. Output directories differ between scorer/rewrite, suites, repeats and selected sets. Keep one active request per provider.

Use two different upstream families from the reviewed fixed seats. Preserve existing MPS/fidelity/HARD_FAIL and number-safety rules. Coordinate judge transport with parent-owned studies; raw rationales remain private.

Separate parent-owned audit smoke checks must use buildPrompt(mode=audit) and the real CLI/output path on source-bound public controls. Existing rewrite/scorer harness has no audit ranking phase. A production CLI check is required because study extraBody forwarding differs.

Apply existing protocol: scorer top two by valid-output rate, AUROC, latency, then two additional repeats; rewrite top two by safe rate, naturalness, latency, then full 34-fixture suite x3. Report per-language uncertainty and label model judgments as model judgments.

Before publishing, parent independently reviews aggregate rows and receipts, model/host identity, rejected/truncated cases, rate/cost completeness, source conflicts and privacy. No winner or production default change without completed evidence.
